WinUI theme options

Six options, all defined by the theme itself and shown under Settings › Appearance › Theme. Everything else (app mode, zoom, playback) is a Wavee setting that every theme reads.
OptionControlValuesDefaultWhat it changes
{{r.name}}{{r.control}}{{r.values}}{{r.def}}{{r.affects}}
Not optionsCorner radii, the type ramp, icon size, pane width (280), player height (72) and the accent-sparingly rule are fixed by the theme. A theme that wants different ones is a different theme.
Classic options that do not applyRow style classic/modern, sidebar Classic/Library, color washes and the track page layout are Classic’s. The WinUI theme hides them; their stored values stay untouched.
Light and darkBoth come from the Wavee app mode (System / Light / Dark). The theme ships both palettes; the first frame after a mode change is already in the new palette.
